program.name: mixed_deletion_signature
program.rationale: Preserve five seed features and replace residual edge count with a demanded mixed deletion signature. The signature combines packing and cover within one feature slot; it does not certify the complete quotient.

program.name: context_seed_conservative
program.rationale: Keeps the seed's packing-cover balance while demanding structural deletion witnesses. The added snapshot terms are constant across roots in a unit-weight snapshot, preserving that part of the local ranking while enriching the interface.

program.name: seed_delete_tilt
program.rationale: Typed aggregates preserve the seed terms while making both root-deletion summaries demanded distinctions; full TRAIN acyclicity remains unverified.

program.name: w3_completion_ratio
program.rationale: Normalize inclusion completions by root-deletion alternatives to reduce sensitivity to graph reward scale. Packing and cover deletion summaries both affect the nonlinear ranking.

program.name: cheap_deletion_bridge
program.rationale: Replace only neighbor packing with demanded deletion packing, retaining the seed's remaining structural measurements. This tests a smaller feature-work change while addressing the displayed interface collision.

program.name: r2_cavity_seed
program.rationale: Retains the seed's completion, triangle and boundary signals while adding delete-root packing sensitivity as a structural discriminator for the failed relations.

program.name: average_conflict_surrogate
program.rationale: Approximate retained and blocked packing from weight and average conflict burden, using only set and edge aggregates. The unit-weight examples motivate this inexpensive density surrogate; weighted products supply secondary distinctions.

program.name: lean_closed_witness
program.rationale: Pairs root-deletion packing with closed-neighborhood packing instead of deletion cover. Tests a cheaper structural alternative with a capped degree correction; neither the displayed join split nor full TRAIN acyclicity is assumed.

program.name: cover_led_boundary
program.rule: weight + 0.2*residual_pack + 0.8*residual_cover + 0.4*(weight + residual_cover - omit_cover) + 0.4*boundary_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1 + degree)) + 0.35*neighbor_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1 + degree)) - 0.04*residual_edges/max(1e-9,abs(1 + compatible_weight)) - 0.005*degree
program.rationale: Tests whether stronger cover and overlap terms recover preferences missed by the seed's packing-heavy estimate. Exclusion cover adds a conditional comparison to the retained structural statistics.

program.name: local_redundancy_density
program.rationale: Use local weighted edge evidence to discount neighbors that cannot coexist. Test reward-aware density with six inexpensive features and no packing or cover calls.

program.name: snapshot_bracket
program.rationale: Demands packing and cover summaries for the residual, deletion and whole snapshot, testing whether broader state distinctions remove quotient cycles beyond the displayed joins.

program.name: interval_gap_switch
program.rationale: Reduce reliance on the conditional upper bound when its gap exceeds the deletion gap. Demand total conflict count as a snapshot signature and density normalization.

program.name: density_switch
program.rationale: Use a snapshot-wide density switch to preserve degree-led choices in sparse patches and prioritize certified feasible completion in denser patches.

program.name: w3_gain_tiers
program.rule: (2+include_pack_gain if include_pack_gain > 1e-8 else (1+include_cover_gain if include_cover_gain > 1e-8 else 0.1*include_pack_gain+0.05*include_cover_gain)) + 0.02*(weight+0.6*residual_pack+0.4*residual_cover) - 0.01*neighbor_pack - 0.001*degree - 0.0001*edge_code/max(1e-9,abs(remaining_count*remaining_count*remaining_count*remaining_count))
program.rationale: Make inclusion-minus-deletion gains explicit typed features and prioritize positive packing gains before cover gains. The completion blend supplies a finer ranking within these heuristic tiers.

program.name: pack_skip
program.rationale: Test a conservative feasible-completion priority with stronger packing margins and explicit displaced packing. The topology summary retains residual, neighborhood and root-excluded edge counts.

program.name: b3obj_weighted_density
program.rationale: Replace retained packing and cover calls with weighted density proxies that reduce to n*n/(n+2*m) on nonempty unit-weight retained sets. One neighborhood packing still prices displacement.

program.name: enum_struct_2_0_75
program.rationale: Fixed catalogue-prefix/coefficient template, not empirical fitting or an experimental LLM authoring draw.

program.name: fixed_base9_00
program.rationale: Frozen classical/base-nine expression; a fixed-information-interface control, not a new authoring draw.
